Interface Coordinate

All Known Implementing Classes:
Coordinate.BlockCoordinate, Coordinate.TrackAndSectorCoordinate, Coordinate.TrackCoordinate
public interface Coordinate
A simplistic set of Coordinates. Note that block only matches to block while track and sector have two forms that match against each other.
